premises: Graphene nanoplatelets can be incorporated into a high-entropy alloy to form a composite with graphene-enriched grain boundaries.
Graphene nanoplatelets provide low shear strength and form a self-lubricating transfer film under mechanical stress.
The transfer film reduces direct asperity contact, lowering friction and wear.
The lubricating effect remains effective across a wide temperature range (-50°C to 600°C).
The predicted friction reduction (20-30%) and wear reduction (order of magnitude) are achievable in this system.
